verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a REST API with read endpoints for faults and projects, plus reporting endpoints for exceptions, deploys and source maps. Its hosted MCP server adds project management, error investigation, BadgerQL queries and full dashboard CRUD. Nothing in the evidence claims UI parity, and many UI actions (resolving errors, alarms, integrations, account and team management, status pages, uptime checks) have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity claim, documented API coverage for write actions like resolve/assign and for alarms, integrations, uptime, check-ins and team management, a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent corroboration.
